title: NILS pipeline results (results.json)
description: What a pipeline says of its run, written to /output/results.json: v0's schema (one entry per work unit with its status, its files, its metrics and its error) and the proposals. The runner reads it after the container exits. Without it, a unit whose declared outputs are found is taken as succeeded and one whose outputs are missing as failed. A unit the file does not name is failed, a file outside /output is refused, and a proposal is passed to the review spine, never written as a fact.

unit_id.description: The unit as /inputs/manifest.json names it: sub-<s>, sub-<s>_ses-<t> or stack-<id> (sub-<s>/ses-<t> and a bare stack id are read too)

proposals.description: Values a model proposes, each on an axis the descriptor declares (proposals.schema.json); the review spine takes them as the model's evidence (record 43 S6)

models.description: The cards (contracts/model/v1) of the models the run used or made: the encoders an embedding names by digest, which the runner registers as encoders when the registry does not hold them, and the card of a model output

margin.description: How far the suggestion stands above the next value, in the pipeline's own measure

source.description: Which pool or rule suggested it

seeds.description: Record 43: suggestions of which stacks a person labels first and with what, distinct from proposals: never a model's decision and never a review item. The runner keeps them as one derivative of kind seeds for the run

stacks.description: The stacks a curation campaign starts from

selection.description: Record 43: the stacks the pipeline suggests curating, which the runner can freeze into a handle for a campaign (nils pipeline seeds <run> --freeze)
